|game_text=Deploy on a system. Your TIEs may relocate (as a regular move) to a system from 0 to 3 parsecs away. For each battleground system you control with two TIEs piloted by Imperials, you may add 3 to your total power in battles. Opponent’s Force drain is +3 here. (Immune to Alter.)
|errata_history={{Card errata/Flagship Operations (V) (Virtual Set 7)}}
|printings={{Card versions/Flagship Operations}}
|notes=The Players Committee released Set 7 on 16 July 2004. [https://web.archive.org/web/20040922081946id_/http://swccgpc.com/interior.htm Release announcement]. The remaster counts two qualifying TIEs piloted by Imperials without the old unique restriction. It explicitly prints a range of zero to three parsecs, consistent with the period rule that permits zero-parsec hyperspeed movement under its usual conditions. The deployment, opposing drain and Alter immunity stay the same. Earlier Decipher Flagship Operations and Set 5 Flagship (V) have separate identities. [https://web.archive.org/web/20090816063441id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/AR/AR1.7.1.pdf#page=60 Period system movement and zero parsecs].
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071026143103/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards7.pdf#page=3 VirtualCards7.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 26 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006; page 3, slip 14. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Flagship Operations]].
* Full-card remaster: [[Virtual Set 7: Shadows Of The Empire#Cards|Virtual Set 7: Shadows Of The Empire]] (fan reconstruction, 2026).
